Fixtures for tests/playbooks.test.mjs: two small kits with every field of docs/kits.md
(kits/), the playbooks written for them (topics/), and the code their errors come from
(sources/), with comments of every kind and a Markdown note there whose words are no
message of a kit, so the loader, the renderer and the checks of the playbooks are tried on
files that are known to be right, and on copies broken one rule at a time.
